## Problem or use case

Describe the task you cannot complete, or the behavior you want to improve.

## Proposed behavior

Explain how it should work. For UI changes, describe where it belongs in the
existing widget or settings; a sketch or screenshot can help.

## Alternatives

Describe any current workaround or other approach you considered.

## Relevant setup

Include Windows/taskbar, monitor or hardware details if the request depends on them.
